scenario: Two same-origin browser tabs resume the same Studio draft after a failed completion request.
command: DATABASE_URL=<disposable-postgres-17> DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED=<disposable-postgres-17> E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3099 npx playwright test tests/e2e/studio-upload-resume.spec.ts --project=chromium

environment.database: Disposable PostgreSQL 17.11, tmpfs, all 84 migrations applied
environment.r2: Controlled mock route; no external R2 access
environment.session: Synthetic signed Better Auth session backed by disposable PostgreSQL

assertions: A second tab on the same origin sees the persisted Studio draft identity.
The second tab validates and resumes the existing draft.
No second draft or multipart upload is created.
The already stored part is not uploaded again; only completion is retried after the controlled 502.
limits: The tabs exercise sequential recovery while the first tab remains open; simultaneous competing uploads are not tested.
Studio API and R2 are controlled; this is not a real Cloudflare R2 ETag/CORS, presigned URL expiry, or provider retry acceptance.
